crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good: so we offer…
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the…
praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I…
that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim…
If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call…
The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ…
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

translations.web: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will heal them.”
translations.bsb: bringing praise to their lips. Peace, peace to those far and near,” says the LORD, “and I will heal them.”

translations.asv: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him that is far off and to him that is near, saith Jehovah; and I will heal him.
